Our two top choices for everyday wear and value are the 457 The Comfort Shaping Bra and the 459 The Comfort Shaping Bra with Adjustable Straps.
Both feature our wirefree CradleLift™ architecture for lift without uniboob, lightweight breathable fabric, and sewn-in pads. The main difference is that the 459 model offers fully adjustable shoulder straps so you can customize the strap length, whereas the 457 model has smooth, hardware-free straps for a completely seamless look under clothes.
